anti_overlap: Leave the survivable-band gauge reading, famine/flood asymmetry, and base-rate-to-reference-class critique to fd-nilometer-flood-band-forecast — this lens is about dispersion and diversity across channels, not where a single aggregate gauge sits

Leave the process-vs-placement / painted-on-glaze / firing-yield framing to fd-anagama-yohen-variance-yield — do not re-argue whether variance emerges from the process; assume it can, and instead judge whether fate is DISPERSED across independent channels and PRESERVED as storable diversity
Do not re-derive the demographics->unrest attribution arithmetic in isolation; use it only as evidence for single-channel dominance / monoculture correlation

Focus on channel independence, cross-channel correlation, landrace/parameter diversity, and durable preservation of that diversity into the chronicle; leave discriminative-power bench statistics as a measurement problem to the nilometer lens and emergence-purity to the anagama lens
decision_lens: Does the calibration make outcomes depend on MANY genuinely independent risk channels (so run-to-run and country-to-country variance is real portfolio dispersion, not a single shared shock), AND does it preserve that diversity all the way into the durable chronicle record — or does one dominant deterministic feed act as a correlated killing frost that collapses the whole harvest to a monoculture regardless of what was planted? Reject any option that leaves a single feed dominating every plot's fate (the demographics->unrest / intrinsic-growth monoculture), or that produces field-level variance which then rots into sameness before it is freeze-dried into the chronicle (variance erased by the 1.0 clamp before T0 is recorded). Prefer the option that both DISPERSES fate across independent channels and reduces cross-channel correlation, and that stores diversity durably — accepting that most plots yield ordinary ware.
distance_rationale: A pre-modern, non-Western high-altitude agricultural and food-preservation practice with millennia of refined intuition about surviving a lethally variable climate by SPREADING risk across independent microclimate channels, preserving genetic (landrace) diversity as insurance, and converting a perishable correlated surplus into a durable storable staple. Semantically distant from software simulation calibration and on none of the AI-cliche domains. Crucially it is structurally distinct from every covered domain: unlike the Nilometer (a single-gauge, single-river, land-in-a-band practice) its core idea is PORTFOLIO DISPERSION and diversity-as-insurance across many independent risks; unlike anagama ceramics it involves no kiln/firing and centers preservation-into-storable-form rather than emergence-from-a-single-process; and it shares no parent discipline with emergent-narrative game design, ABM calibration methodology, or benchmark design. It is structurally isomorphic to the monoculture-collapse core of the calibration question: one correlated deterministic feed harvesting all 221 seeds identically is precisely the killing-frost-on-a-monoculture failure the Andean system evolved to defeat.
expected_isomorphisms: A single dominant deterministic feed (demographics->unrest / intrinsic growth) applied identically to all 221 countries maps to a genetic + microclimate MONOCULTURE: one correlated killing frost that harvests every plot identically, producing the month-6 bit-identical / same-56-countries / Jaccard-1.00 collapse regardless of what seed was sown.

The vertical-archipelago dispersal of many small plots across independent altitude/microclimate bands maps to spreading run-fate across many genuinely independent, DECORRELATED stochastic channels (agent draws, forcing phase, GDP trajectory, cascade draws) — dispersion fails not only when channels are few but when they co-move, just as scattered plots under one weather system are still a monoculture.

Mixed native landraces with heterogeneous frost/blight/drought tolerance map to preserving heterogeneous per-country and per-family susceptibility across the 13 pressure families, so different plots fail under different shocks rather than all on the same day — homogenized susceptibility is planting one clone everywhere.

Freeze-drying the surviving harvest into chuño/moraya — turning a perishable, correlated glut into a durable STORABLE staple — maps to the chronicle/predicate pipeline preserving seed-distinguishable diversity into a durable record BEFORE the 1.0 pressure clamp rots it into an undifferentiated saturated maximum; variance that saturates before it is freeze-dried leaves no diversity to draw on for canon fingerprints or bench discrimination.

The farmer's judgment of the system by whether it SPREADS risk and PRESERVES diversity (not by any one spectacular plot) maps to a portfolio-yield acceptance metric — spread of T0, a cross-channel correlation ceiling, a per-family variance-retained floor — over any single dramatic run, while over-diversifying into implausible independent noise-worlds is the failure of a field scattered so wide it no longer tracks the real climate.
focus: Validating that the calibration spreads outcome-risk across MANY INDEPENDENT stochastic channels and preserves genuine varietal diversity — the way Andean agropastoralists survive a killing altiplano climate not by landing one gauge in a band but by scattering dozens of tiny plots across altitude/microclimate bands and planting mixed landraces so no single frost, hail, blight or drought erases the whole harvest, then freeze-drying the surplus into chuño so the diversity is preserved as a durable, storable staple rather than rotting into an undifferentiated mush.
name: fd-chuno-landrace-portfolio-dispersion
persona: Apply the perspective of a Quechua/Aymara altiplano farmer-herder working the vertical archipelago at 3,800-4,200m: they do not bet the household on one field or one seed potato. They plant many small chacras dispersed across altitude bands, aspects and soil types, sow deliberately mixed landrace populations (dozens of named papas nativas, each with different frost/blight/drought tolerance), and stagger planting dates — because the enemy is a single correlated shock (an early heladas frost, a hailstorm, a wet blight year) that would wipe a monoculture but only ever takes a fraction of a dispersed, diverse portfolio. What survives the field they then process through the alternating overnight-frost / daytime-sun-and-trampling cycle into chuño and moraya: a freeze-dried staple that stores for years, turning a perishable, correlated glut into a durable, drawable reserve. They judge a system by whether it SPREADS risk and PRESERVES diversity into something storable — not by whether any one plot looked spectacular. Here the 'field portfolio' is the seed sweep, each 'plot/microclimate band' is an independent stochastic channel in the sim (agent RNG, forcing phase, GDP trajectory, cascade draws), the 'landrace mix' is the genetic/parameter diversity across the 221 countries and 13 pressure families, the 'killing frost' is a deterministic feed applied identically to every plot, and 'chuño' is the durable chronicle/predicate record the variance must survive into.
review_areas: Whether the month-6 bit-identical collapse is diagnosable as a MONOCULTURE FAILURE — one correlated shock (the demographics->unrest + intrinsic-growth feeds) so dominant it kills every plot regardless of what landrace was sown — and whether any option actually reduces that single-channel dominance vs. merely lowering its magnitude while it stays the sole determinant of fate across all 221 countries

Channel-independence audit: enumerate the stochastic channels that are SUPPOSED to disperse risk (agent draws, scripted-player deployments, engine GDP trajectories, emergence RNG, cascade draws) and check which actually reach the state that decides T0 — the brief's structural sub-finding that CLI --seed never reaches new_full_world_with_seed means a channel that looks independent is a plot planted with the same clone, so verify how many channels are genuinely decorrelated after the deterministic feed dominates

Cross-channel CORRELATION, not just count: even multiple feeds can be a monoculture if they co-move (all rising monotonically to saturation together); flag whether Option A's rebalanced feeds still push every family/country in lockstep, so the 'portfolio' is many plots exposed to one weather system rather than dispersed across microclimates

Landrace/parameter diversity across the 221 countries and 13 families: whether the calibration preserves heterogeneous per-country and per-family susceptibility (different frost/blight tolerances) or homogenizes them so all plots fail on the same day — the same-56-countries / Jaccard-1.00 evidence read as every plot carrying identical genetics

Chuño-preservation: whether the freeze-thaw step that makes variance STORABLE — the chronicle/predicate pipeline reading T0/epicenter/leading-family — captures the dispersion before the 1.0 pressure clamp rots it into an undifferentiated maximum; a diverse field that saturates before it is freeze-dried leaves no durable diversity to draw on for canon or bench discrimination

Portfolio-yield acceptance: whether the calibration is judged by a dispersion/diversity metric (spread of T0 dates, count of decorrelated seed-distinct chronicles, per-family variance retained) rather than by any single dramatic run — and whether over-diversifying into pure noise (a scattered field of implausible independent worlds) is distinguished from legitimate risk-spread that still tracks a real crisis structure

severity_examples.condition: The harvest is still a monoculture: seed 'diversity' is planted but one shared shock harvests the whole field identically, so ShadowBench cannot discriminate decision policies and canon cannot be seed-fingerprinted — the calibration looks retuned but the portfolio has one point of failure
severity_examples.scenario: The ruling adopts an option (e.g. Option A alone, or C's conditional feeds) that keeps a single deterministic feed as the dominant determinant of every country's fate — merely retuning its magnitude — so all 221 plots remain a genetic monoculture exposed to one correlated killing frost, and run-to-run variance stays a cosmetic function of channels that never reach the collapse-deciding state

severity_examples.condition: Count of channels rises but cross-channel correlation stays near 1, and the diversity that does exist rots into a shared maximum before T0 is recorded — dispersion is nominal, not real, and the durable chronicle preserves no seed-distinguishable diversity
severity_examples.scenario: Multiple independent stochastic channels are wired in (Option B seeds the emergence RNG + slow forcing) but they are highly correlated — all drift monotonically toward saturation on the same schedule — so the portfolio is many plots under one weather system, and the field still saturates and clamps at 1.0 before the chronicle freeze-dries the reading

severity_examples.condition: Non-binding diversity: the firing has no portfolio-yield criterion, so a re-collapsed monoculture (all plots one weather) or an over-scattered noise field (implausible independent worlds) can silently pass, leaving 'variance is dispersed and preserved' unmeasured
severity_examples.scenario: The calibration acceptance criterion is stated only as a steady-state band with no dispersion/diversity metric — no required spread of T0 across a sweep, no cross-channel correlation ceiling, no per-family variance-retained floor — so a low-correlation genuinely-dispersed calibration and a high-correlation monoculture that happens to sit in-band both pass

source_domain: Andean high-altitude agropastoralism — chuño/moraya freeze-dried potato production and the vertical-archipelago strategy of dispersing many small plots across microclimate/altitude bands with mixed native landraces as correlated-shock insurance
success_hints: Read design/2026-07-10-jackpot-calibration-brief.md sections 1-4 to ground which feeds dominate fate and which stochastic channels exist, before judging channel independence and correlation

For every option, list the channels that decide T0 and estimate their pairwise correlation — treat a single dominant monotonic feed as a genetic monoculture regardless of how many other channels nominally exist

Check crates/shadowbench-core/src/emergence/ for whether per-country/per-family susceptibility is heterogeneous (real landrace diversity) or homogenized, and where (if anywhere) the seed actually decorrelates the collapse-deciding channels

Trace whether the chronicle/predicate pipeline reads T0 BEFORE the 1.0 pressure clamp — a diverse field that saturates before being freeze-dried into the chronicle preserves no durable diversity, so name the clamp/record ordering as the freeze-drying failure

Propose a concrete portfolio-yield metric (spread of T0 across a seed sweep, a cross-channel correlation ceiling, a per-family variance-retained floor) as the acceptance criterion, and distinguish legitimate risk-spread from over-diversification into implausible noise
task_context: maximize verified novelty×risk surface until dry — answering: what makes for the most interesting gameplay + scientific/policy simulation validity/fidelity for shadow-work? The live decision is a calibration ruling: every run collapses bit-identically at month 6 because deterministic feeds (demographics->unrest, intrinsic economic-strain growth) out-inject decay at every pressure level, ratcheting all 221 countries to saturation and clamping at 1.0, erasing seed variance. Options A (rebalance feeds vs decay), B (seed the emergence RNG + slow-forcing variance), and C (start-state grace + conditional feeds) are on the table. This lens evaluates whether the ruling disperses fate across many genuinely independent, decorrelated stochastic channels and preserves per-country/per-family diversity into the durable chronicle record — i.e. escapes the monoculture-killed-by-one-frost failure — rather than merely retuning the single dominant shock.
